name: Gasthaus Bierstindl
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to Gasthaus Bierstindl in Innsbruck** Nestled in the heart of **Tirol**, just a stone’s throw from the vibrant city center of **Innsbruck**, **Gasthaus Bierstindl** invites you to experience authentic Tyrolean hospitality in a cozy, rustic setting. Whether you're craving hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, a perfectly seared **Kaiserschmarrn**, or a cold **Tiroler Bier** from the local brewery, our traditional dishes and warm atmosphere will make you feel right at home. After a day of exploring the stunning **Nordkette**, the charming **Altstadt**, or the nearby **Alpenzoo**, unwind with a glass of **Apfelstrudel** or a steaming cup of **Kaffee mit Schlag**. Our sunlit beer garden—ideal for summer evenings—offers a relaxed escape, while the crackling fireplace in winter creates an intimate ambiance. Just a short walk from **Innsbruck’s main train station**, we’re your perfect base for discovering the beauty of **Tirol**. Come for the food, stay for the stories—**Bierstindl** is where memories are made, one bite (and sip) at a time. --- **

Unser Tipp:

** Try our **"Bierstindl-Spezial"**—a hearty platter of **Schweinsbraten** with **Krautsalat** and a side of **Knödel**, served with a frothy pint of our house **Tiroler Bier**. *Prost!*
